result.summary: Updated install.sh: now installs all 9 unit files (fetch, summarize, api, orchestrate, watchdog service+timer each). Enables and starts github-digest-api.service, github-digest-orchestrate.timer, github-digest-watchdog.timer in addition to existing fetch/summarize timers. Creates /var/log/github-digest with proper ownership. Updated uninstall.sh: now stops/disables/removes orchestrate and watchdog units in addition to existing ones.
